# Kavach documentation index

Every document in `docs/`, grouped by area. Kavach is observation-only: it records, scores and explains; it never contains, blocks or remediates. See [README.md](README.md) for the short reading order and [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml) for the HTTP contract (every registered route is listed there; a Go test enforces it).

## Keeping the docs honest

- `go test ./internal/edr -run TestOpenAPICoversRegisteredRoutes` fails when a registered route is missing from `openapi.yaml`; intentional omissions go in `openapiAllowlist` in `internal/edr/openapi_routes_test.go` with a reason (currently none).
- `ruby docs/tools/inventory.rb --check` fails when the inventory above is stale.
- Observation-only note: documentation of scheduled detections, exceptions, attack chains, case templates, fleet SLO, scheduled reports, blind spots and content versions currently lives in `openapi.yaml`, `persistence-files.md` and the competitive matrix evidence; dedicated feature docs have not been written yet.
